title: Navy pilots interviewed, including Fravor and Dietrich of the 2004 Tic Tac case
place_text: Off the coast of the United States

tellings.quote: Skinwalker Ranch. Uh we interviewed Navy pilots uh a succession of them. We also [clears throat] found Dave Fraver and Alex Dietrich who had been pilots in the Tic Tac episode back in 2004.

plain: A former US Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says he and his colleagues interviewed a string of Navy pilots about unexplained objects. Among them they tracked down the Navy pilots David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, who in 2004 had flown in the Tic Tac episode, where pilots off the US coast reported a white oval object shaped like the mint. McConnell tells it as part of his own work, which shows that Senate staff were taking the pilots' accounts seriously.
